purpose: gamepipe1-off: creates /var/db/nord2-metal/no-gamepipe (content 'made-by-gamepipe1'): all y2s86 additions off (thumbfix5 behaviour) at the next launch of each process. Removed by gamepipe1-undo, or by gamepipe1-off with the payload file 'remove' (payload-gamepipe1-on).
kernel_image: any kernel (userland only); the phone's current image
